**FINDING #10 + doctrine candidate: gate tests with default readers over the real repo = verdicts coupled to committed state**

What: Finding #10 — a hermeticity bug in the tests shipped in PR #227 (run-check.test.mjs). Two memory-gate tests that expect FAIL injected `readChunks` but NOT `readRecords`, so the runner's default `readRecords` read the REAL `.memory/records/`. On the tracker (no records/) they passed; on the cutover branch (33 session_summaries in records/) the gate wrongly PASSES and the fail-expecting test FAILS. A test whose verdict depends on committed memory state.

Reproduced hermetically (no real-store mutation): runCheck('memory-gate', {cwd: <dir with records/session_summary>, readChunks: () => [{type:'decision'}]}) → {pass:true} (wrong); same with a records-less cwd → {pass:false} (correct).

The two active bugs: "injected chunks have no session_summary → fail" and "main: memory-gate failing → returns 1". Audit found 3 more latent violations (tests injecting only readChunks that happened to still pass). Fix: all 5 memory-gate tests now inject BOTH readChunks AND readRecords (readRecords: () => [] where records must be empty). Verified: run the test file from a cwd WITH records/ present → all 7 memory-gate subtests pass. Full suite 1049 pass.

Sibling observation (NOT fixed, intentional): the decision-gate ci-context-seam test (run-check.test.mjs, "deps.ctx.baseSha/headSha take precedence...") runs real `git diff HEAD...HEAD` via the default diffNameOnly path — it deliberately exercises real git as the thing under test (passes in-repo). Different class from the accidental-default memory bug.

DOCTRINE CANDIDATE (human ruling, register in catalog or testing doctrine): runCheck gate tests MUST inject ALL evidence sources; never inherit a default that reads the real world (real .memory/ or real git). Rule of thumb encoded in the file header comment: "whoever injects one gate reader injects both." Generalization: any pure-check runner test that leaves an I/O dep at its default couples the verdict to ambient repo state.

Where: brain/scripts/governance/run-check.test.mjs (header comment + 5 memory-gate tests). Related: [[governance/memory-gate-records-aware]] (PR #227, where the bug shipped), unblocks cutover #225.
